latestVersion.changelog:
High-Intent Lead Sniper 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Instantly finds B2B leads showing real buying intent via recent funding, hiring, tech stack changes, competitor frustrations, and LinkedIn trigger events.
- Integrates signals from Apify (LinkedIn, Crunchbase, Twitter, Google News, Wappalyzer), InVideo AI, and Claude AI for workflow automation.
- Scores leads based on real-time intent, providing ranked lists and hyper-personalized outreach templates for each prospect.
- Designed for any B2B sales, SaaS, or agency team seeking more replies and faster conversions by contacting leads at the exact buying moment.
- Offers sophisticated lead gen signals comparable to $30k–$100k/year solutions for a fraction of the price.
